# Graph operations · material

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### material.base

Read the resolved shared material settings and derive pixel and physical sampling extents.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `settings` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `width` | `pixelCount` | — | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Output | `height` | `pixelCount` | — | pixels · {"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Output | `samples` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `pixelPitchMm` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |
| Output | `physicalSizeMm` | `vec2` | — | {"dimensions":2,"finite":true} |
| Output | `tiling` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `seed` | `number` | — | {"finite":true} |

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.base --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.channel

Read a named raster and its metadata from a material port.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `name` | `string` | Required |  |
| Output | `value` | `raster` | — | {"layout":"Interleaved samples on a positive integer grid","channels":[1,4],"finite":true} |
| Output | `metadata` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../graph-image-types.md#send-images-through-materials-and-legacy-nodes), [guide](../material-graph-ports.md#read-and-edit-maps)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.channel --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.image

Read a contracted image and its material metadata without dropping the image contract.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `materialChannels` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |
| Input | `name` | `string` | Required |  |
| Output | `value` | `typedImage` | — | {"layout":"Versioned raster and declared image contract"} |
| Output | `metadata` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

### material.imageOutput

Fit a typed image to the shared material extent, tiling and physical pixel pitch.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `source` | `typedImage` | Required | {"layout":"Versioned raster and declared image contract"} |
| Input | `settings` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `typedImage` | — | {"layout":"Versioned raster and declared image contract"} |

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.imageOutput --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.pack

Bundle named material rasters into one typed port, with independent map sizes and metadata.

Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `maps` | `record` | Required | Channel names mapped to raster values. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Input | `metadata` | `record` | `{}` | Optional JSON metadata keyed by supplied channel. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `materialChannels` | — | {"layout":"Versioned named raster channels with independent grids and metadata","minItems":1,"maxItems":64} |

Guides: [guide](../graph-image-types.md#send-images-through-materials-and-legacy-nodes), [guide](../material-graph-ports.md#read-and-edit-maps)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe material.pack --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.

### material.replace

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Input | `metadata` | `record` | `{}` | Optional JSON metadata keyed by supplied channel. · {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
